title: aegilops cylindrica f. ferruginea
intro: Aegilops cylindrica f. ferruginea, commonly known as 'slender wild goat-grass', is a type of plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Aegilops cylindrica f. ferruginea include its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
